subject: Renewal planning: timing, staffing, and QBR availability
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Park <susan@paxora.com>, Tim Bell <tim.bell@paxora.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: timing, staffing, and QBR availability

Hi Susan / Tim —

Thanks for the continued partnership — Paxora's contract comes up in ~60 days and I wanted to kick off a short renewal/origination process so we can align on capacity, pricing, and a QBR window. High-level proposal and asks: 

- Timeline: goal is signature (or agreed plan) within 45 days so we can reserve capacity for your projected ramp.
- Capacity: we saw a sustained +18–22% token/embedding growth last quarter; please confirm your FY usage projection (we included a short usage export).
- Terms/upsell: if Paxora is comfortable, we can present a staircase discount tied to committed throughput and a burst pool for unpredictable spikes.
- QBR: would like to schedule a 60-min QBR in the next 2–3 weeks to review roadmap, ops, and contract terms. Please share 3 preferred windows or use the poll link below.

Attachments: MADP-usage-report-March2029.xlsx (usage by route), Paxora-MAP-v1.pdf (draft mutual action plan)
Poll: https://cal.com/paxora-qbr-poll

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm who should attend from Paxora (billing, platform, ops).
2) We schedule QBR and I will share a short pre-read (MAP + usage).
3) Ben will draft term options; Karthik will run capacity validation for the requested uplift.

If helpful I can propose two time slots now: Tue 03/26 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 03/28 14:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Renewal planning: timing, staffing, and QBR availability

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers: 

- Attendees from Paxora: myself (billing/partnership), Tim Bell (platform lead), and Leah Gomez (ML infra) — I'll loop Leah after this.
- Usage: we'll confirm updated projections by EOD Monday; short story is we are budgeting for ~20% growth and plan to enable another high-throughput endpoint in Q3.
- QBR windows: Tue 03/26 10:00–11:00 PT works best for Tim and me. If that slot is still open, please lock it.

A couple of asks from our side before the QBR: 
1) Sample term options (monthly vs. annual commit) and what burst pricing looks like.
2) A short ops-runbook checklist for on-call and incident postmortem expectations when the new endpoint is live.

I've attached a short slide deck that outlines Paxora's expected growth and timeline.

Attachment: Paxora-expected-growth-slides.pdf

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Susan's reply. Quick internal split of ownership so we move fast: 

- Ben: lead on commercial options and draft of term scenarios (monthly commit, 12-month staircase, burst pool rates). Please include an example P&L for Paxora at +0%, +20%, +40% YOY usage. 
- Karthik: capacity/ops validation and runbook doc (include expected latency SLOs, scaling lag, warm GPU pool behavior, and KV-cache considerations for the new high-throughput endpoint).
- I'll coordinate the QBR logistics and the MAP pre-read. Lock Tue 03/26 10:00–11:00 PT with Paxora if that slot is still open.

Internal checklist to prepare before QBR: 
• Commercial: term options + redline-lite contract draft (Ben)
• Technical: capacity plan + ops-runbook (Karthik)
• Pre-read: usage export + MAP (I'll circulate)

I attached the usage export for quick reference.

Attachment: MADP-usage-report-March2029.xlsx

Please reply with any blockers; otherwise I'll book the slot and send invites with a 15-min pre-read.

Thanks,
Mina
